title: A divisor cannot carry more copies of a prime than the multiset does
statement: Let m be a Nat.Multiset all of whose elements are prime, and let d be a positive divisor of the product of m. Then at every value q, the multiplicity of q in the computed factorization of d is at most its multiplicity in m. This is the valuation-comparison half of the divisors-to-selections correspondence: ADR-1658 named it as the missing prerequisite for surjectivity (every divisor of a squarefree n IS a selection of its prime multiset), where prodSel_dvd_prod already gives the converse.

formal.statement: theorem Nat.Multiset.count_le_of_dvd_prod : ((x0 : AxNat.Multiset) -> ((x1 : AxNat) -> ((x2 : AxNat) -> ((x3 : ((x3 : AxNat) -> ((x4 : AxNat.lt AxNat.zero (AxNat.Multiset.count x0 x3)) -> And (AxNat.le (AxNat.succ (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero)) x3) (((x5 : AxNat) -> ((x6 : AxNat.dvd x5 x3) -> Or (Eq.{1} AxNat x5 (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero)) (Eq.{1} AxNat x5 x3))))))) -> ((x4 : AxNat.lt AxNat.zero x1) -> ((x5 : AxNat.dvd x1 (AxNat.Multiset.prod x0)) -> AxNat.le (AxNat.Multiset.count (AxNat.factorization x1) x2) (AxNat.Multiset.count x0 x2)))))))

evidence.supports: Nat.Multiset.count_le_of_dvd_prod is admitted by the trusted kernel gate with the type recorded in formal.statement.
evidence.checker_command: test "$(cargo run -q --release -p axeyum-lean-kernel --example nat_theorem_inventory -- Nat.Multiset.count_le_of_dvd_prod 2>/dev/null | grep -Fc 'AxNat.le (AxNat.Multiset.count (AxNat.factorization x1) x2) (AxNat.Multiset.count x0 x2)')" -ge 1
evidence.notes: The pattern is the CONCLUSION as rendered by Kernel::render_lean, in its admitted direction, so a transposed statement fails this check. ADR-1658 sized this as a bounded induction in multiset.rs's idiom; it is neither. Both valuation halves already existed, so the argument is one Nat.lt_or_ge at the two counts -- whose right half IS the goal -- plus three dvd_trans steps in the left half, contradicting not_pow_succ_count_dvd_prod. Nat.lt n m IS Nat.le (succ n) m definitionally here, so no succ_le_of_lt is needed and none exists.

notes: Landed by lane mobius-transfer (ADR-1671), closing ADR-1658's missing piece A. Surjectivity itself does NOT follow yet: with s q := ble 1 (count (factorization d) q) and a squarefree m this gives count (restrict m s) q = count (factorization d) q at every q, but concluding prodSel m s = d needs count-agreement to imply prod-agreement, and the two multisets have DIFFERENT BOUNDS. The missing lemma is a prodRange range-stability law, not a valuation bound -- so the blocker moved rather than disappearing.
